lens4_audits.public_summary: Xu et al. (2012) establish active sensorimotor dendritic calcium spikes in barrel cortex while lacking abstract internal task-rule dendritic representations, SST-mediated rule gating, and rule-switching choice control. After Micah Blumberg 2022 immutable Git SAN anchors (a0090z, a0642z, a0310zNAPOT5), Zhang, Xu et al. (2025-06-04 bioRxiv v1) assemble all 9 joined dendritic rule-decision families simultaneously, with 7 of 9 confirmed in the 2026-10-15 Science public summary. Because the paywalled Science 2026 full body remains source-gated, conservative Lens 4 stays LSM-UNKNOWN (ceiling LSM-COMPONENT-SHIFT; quantitative-not-calibrated; access, copying, and intent unproven; 10 independent lineages credited).

lens4_audits.public_summary: Program-level longitudinal audit of Dehaene Global Neuronal Workspace spanning 2015-05-21 through 2025-10-09 against Micah Blumberg dated SAN/SIT records (2011-08-24 through 2025-02-22) across 145 certified comparisons. Both signature families are verified in the newest archived stage while independent domain lineages remain credited; classification stays conservatively at LSM-UNKNOWN with zero motive or access inference.

The checked Chalmers record (25 frozen texts from 1990 to 2025, and one source-gated 2012 reply) states global availability; constructed perception; organizational invariance; extended coupling; welfare and governance; identity, continuity and memory; virtual realism; and emulation and uploading before Micah Blumberg's dated 2011-2025 genealogy. Recurrence and feedback; world-models; self-models; senses, embodiment and agency; and assessment by indicators and credences are first stated together in 2023, after Micah's dated anchors, and again in 2024; the newest checked text states none of them as its own requirement. This private result is component-level and uncalibrated: it is not a persistent certified cluster, a derivation probability, or an access-and-intent finding.

lens4_audits.public_summary: Program-level longitudinal audit of Dehaene Global Neuronal Workspace spanning 2015-05-21 through 2025-10-09 against Micah Blumberg dated SAN/SIT records (2011-08-24 through 2025-02-22) across 145 certified comparisons. Both signature families are verified in the newest archived stage while independent domain lineages remain credited; classification stays conservatively at LSM-UNKNOWN with zero motive or access inference.

The checked Chalmers record (25 frozen texts from 1990 to 2025, and one source-gated 2012 reply) states global availability; constructed perception; organizational invariance; extended coupling; welfare and governance; identity, continuity and memory; virtual realism; and emulation and uploading before Micah Blumberg's dated 2011-2025 genealogy. Recurrence and feedback; world-models; self-models; senses, embodiment and agency; and assessment by indicators and credences are first stated together in 2023, after Micah's dated anchors, and again in 2024; the newest checked text states none of them as its own requirement. This private result is component-level and uncalibrated: it is not a persistent certified cluster, a derivation probability, or an access-and-intent finding.
